limitations: Single mp and single high-temperature run; overlapping time windows, atoms, controls and time origins are not independent repeats.
No full host/Na trajectory, original CIF, raw MD input, stepwise temperature log or original workbook was read.
C nearest-partner ID invariance is an original-report claim; the actual nearest-C partner table was not uploaded.
CC per-frame contact table and canonical CC image labels are absent; CC lifetime and complete-with-CC all-frame counts remain summary evidence.
Sn/C/Na–O/F canonical labels are present in E but lack independent host-coordinate validation; NC host positions and physical passage are null.
Host rigid/nonrigid global residuals and detailed reference-region visits are missing; cited original-report numbers are not promoted to recomputed evidence.
Initial occupied reference balls are not a complete site universe; vacancy_fraction remains null.

No barriers, formation energies, verified substitution stability, electronic conductivity, electrochemical window, interface reaction data, mechanical pressure range, room-temperature conductivity, reversible voltage/capacity or device qualification.
No inference of a unique solid/liquid/disordered phase from MSD and contact summaries; thermal-history effects remain unresolved.
Specific precursor costs and toxicological/SDS classifications were not verified; no claim of low cost or nontoxic synthesis is made.
